Message:
Together, the tortoise and the hare
traveled to many faraway lands.

In the land of the cat and mouse,
the pair was able to stop
their long-held feud
and help them reconcile.

In the forest where
the wolf and the bear clashed,
they brought in a tiger
as a mediator to fairly divide
each animal’s territory.

They drove away the bat
who spread discord and,
with the help of a wise owl,
lit the way for all the animals
towards the path of truth.

But, the road to peace
was never easy.

Whenever the hare and her friends
wanted to give up,
the tortoise’s bright smile
urged them on.
“We can’t quit now.
Let’s see this through.”

“I’m supposed to be
helping him out,
but he’s always the one
supporting us...”
she thought.

So, the hare vowed
to protect the tortoise
until the bitter end.

After countless
trials and tribulations,
the pair finally defied
the world’s fated destruction.
And they lived happily ever after.

...Or so you’d think, right?
But come on,
there’s no such thing
as a happy ending.
